title: Chapter 214 Easily Defeating The Demon Tribe
content:
Chapter 214 Easily Defeating The Demon Tribe

The Demonic Army continued to charge desperately, but it could not break through the long-range firepower defense line of the Zerg ground forces.

Faced with this situation, the troops on both sides of the Demonic Army phalanx began to detour to the left and right of the battlefield, trying to avoid the area with the strongest firepower in front of the Zerg Army phalanx.

Now it was time to test the range of the Zerg destroyers. The firepower of the Zerg destroyers followed the demonic army's detours, extending to the left and right sides of the battlefield, and constantly chasing them.

The super long-range range displayed by the Zerg destroyers once again amazed people.

Especially Naga, who had asked Wu Qing for these Zerg destroyers on the battlefield, was in a very good mood. The performance of the Zerg destroyers had exceeded her expectations.

The range of the Zerg destroyers was also limited, and the longer the range, the lower their attack frequency.

But this was enough. The strength of the Demonic Army was also limited. They kept detouring to both sides and lengthening the front line, and the strength of these detour troops became very sparse.

The Zerg dragon group that was slaughtering the demon army indiscriminately flew out in part to clean up the sparse demon army on both sides of the battlefield.

Those demon army that had been beaten to pieces successfully bypassed the Zerg army on both sides, but they were no match for the Zerg dogs.

Even if they continued to bypass and attack the Naga army, it would be like a sheep walking into the tiger's mouth.

The outcome of this battle was no longer suspenseful!

More than three million demon army fought against more than 1.4 million Zerg army and lost miserably. They were completely restrained by the Zerg army.

The Zerg army defeated the more than three million demon army almost without any damage. When the strength of the demon army dropped below one million, the Zerg ground forces took the initiative to attack. They projected more firepower into the demon army and accelerated the demise of the demon army.

A group of 100,000 Zerg dragons all flew over the demon army and carried out the most efficient attack.

"Boom boom..."

"Stab stab stab..."

The Zerg army was all long-range firepower, and this was a war without any close combat.

Countless demon soldiers fell under the various long-range attacks of the Zerg army, and they did not cause any damage to the Zerg army.

The Zerg's long-range soldiers, except for the Zerg Hydralisk, all had area-killing attacks, and even the Zerg Hydralisk had the ability to spray Zerg biological decomposition fluid to kill the area.

This combination is very efficient in clearing enemies with weak individual strength.

The vast majority of the more than three million demon army were ordinary inferior demons. No matter how they struggled, they could not escape the fate of being quickly slaughtered.

At the end of this war, because the demon army kept trying to detour, many demon soldiers had already run away, and the millions of Zerg puppies who had been waiting for orders were all dispatched to clear the huge battlefield area.

Soon, there was no more soldier of the demon army on the entire battlefield.

The Zerg dragons and Zerg dogs rushed to the Demon Citadel at the rear of the battlefield, and also attacked the Demon Citadel, which was almost unguarded.

A war between millions of troops ended with the complete victory of the Zerg army. More than three million troops of the Demon Citadel were annihilated, and nothing was left except some fire energy crystals.

The more than three million Naga troops that had finally gathered were watching the show the whole time, watching the Zerg army's extremely wonderful performance from afar.

The observers from various forces who came to watch the battle witnessed the powerful strength of the Zerg through this battle.

The overall strength level of the army sent by the Zerg this time was not high, and the strongest strength was only three stars, but they showed the Zerg's extremely powerful combat potential.

Who knows how many high-star strength arms the Zerg has?

Even if the army in front of them was pulled to the main battlefield of the camp war, it would not be a weak brigade.

…

“It’s not easy to gather so many troops here. Do you want me to help clean up the demon territory?”

Naga had already negotiated with Wu Qing on the conditions for the Naga tribe to evacuate. She did not delay and immediately prepared for the evacuation.

The logistics supply of more than three million troops is very difficult. If there is no war, the assembled troops must be disbanded immediately and dispersed.

“No, we will deal with the remaining enemies of the demon tribe ourselves!”

Wu Qing rejected Naga’s kindness.

Killing enemies can earn resources, so it is better to be slow than to let others intervene. Moreover, he is still thinking about the population in the demon territory.

“Well, I will organize the evacuation as soon as possible!”

“The troops here are all my accumulated assets. I will take them away, including the families of these soldiers and some tribesmen!”

“The rest of the population will be left to you!”

Naga 妶 explained to Wu Qing.

“No problem!”

Wu Qing did not think about accepting the Naga army, as long as he could accept most of the territory population.

To support such a large army, the population of the Naga territory is a very large number.

There are many large cities. If this place is not special, the Naga tribe will not easily give up this territory.

The situation in the Tengu territory is similar. In order to prevent some people in the Tengu tribe from being unwilling and deliberately causing trouble for the Zerg, Wu Qing is ready to take action immediately.

First give the Tengu tribe a significant warning, and then send Zerg hosts to monitor the cities in the entire Tengu territory around the clock to ensure that the Tengu tribe does not make small moves behind the scenes.

"Elder, I need to talk to the representative of the Tengu tribe!"

Wu Qing said to Naga.

This is still the territory of the Naga tribe. The representatives of various forces are guests of the Naga tribe. Wu Qing wants to find the representative of the Tengu tribe, so he must communicate with Naga first.

"No problem, you really need to talk to avoid causing a conflict!"

Naga understood Wu Qing's concerns, and she also had some understanding of the current style of the Tengu tribe.

The Naga army began to organize an evacuation, and the battlefield and the demon territory were handed over to the Zerg.

After this battle, the strength of the demon army has been very weak. The Zerg has flying arms such as the flying dragon group, and it is not difficult to clear the demon castle on the front line.

Not long after, the people sent by Naga invited the representative of the Tengu tribe, who was a middle-aged Tengu tribe man who looked very humble.

"Greetings, elders, and lords!"

The Tengu tribe representative stepped forward to greet Naga and Wu Qing.

"No need to be polite. I asked you to come here because Lord Wu Qing wants to discuss something with you!"

Naga said straight to the point.

Wu Qing did not shy away from Naga, and took over the conversation and said: "Since it is difficult for us to meet the high-ranking nobles, we can only invite them on the battlefield!"

"I have some words that I would like you to take back. If possible, please ask the noble leader to talk to me in person!"

"The current situation is very clear. The territories of the two tribes in the evil god camp have fallen into our hands. The Naga tribe has also negotiated with us and is willing to evacuate this area!"

"Only you Tengu tribe are left. It is still unknown where to go!"

"The Zerg entered the world, and this is the birthplace. It is of great significance. Here is the protection of the Zerg master. It is a territory we must take down!"

"My suggestion is that in order to avoid unnecessary conflicts, the nobles will voluntarily evacuate this area, and we will give certain compensation!"

"It is best for the nobles not to cause trouble. Even if the nobles are exhausted, we can fight!"

Wu Qing simply expressed his thoughts, mainly to let the Tengu tribe know the meaning of his last two sentences.

If the Tengu tribe evacuates on their own initiative, they will get some compensation. If they refuse to leave, they will be beaten!

This is the last warning. The next time they appear, the Zerg will be a large army.

The Tengu representative listened to Wu Qing's words carefully. After Wu Qing finished speaking, he responded: "Don't worry, Lord, I will definitely convey my words!"

Such a big event is not something that he, a representative, can decide. From his point of view, he does not want to see the Tengu and Zerg conflict. He will bring back everything he saw and heard on the battlefield today.

"I also know a little about your Tengu affairs. It's better not to make a strong enemy over such a small matter!"

Naga did not forget to add a sentence.

From the perspective of the Naga, she did not want the Tengu and Zerg to conflict. If the two tribes go to war, the hatred will be great and will affect the entire local camp.

"Thank you for the reminder, elder. I will take the elder's opinion back!"

"You should go back as soon as possible! These things cannot be delayed!"

"..."

Seeing that Wu Qing stopped talking, Naga sent the Tengu representative away.

At this time, Gong Zhe from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce came to visit.

After some polite talk, Gong Zhe said to Naga, "Elder, our Goblin Chamber of Commerce needs to borrow the nobles' space transmission channel to transmit a batch of important materials. I wonder if it is feasible?"

The Naga tribe and the Tengu tribe have built space transmission channels in this area. The tribes of the two tribes are in very remote places. This is considered an enclave, and the space transmission channel is used to connect the tribe.

The news that the Naga tribe is preparing to evacuate has not yet spread, and Gong Zhe did not know about this.

Naga smiled and said, "No problem, our tribe will completely withdraw from this area within ten days, and this space transmission channel will remain here. You can use it however you want, as long as the lord agrees!"

Naga said, looking at Wu Qing.

Wu Qing also smiled and said, "Of course no problem!"

"Is that so? That's great!"

"We are sincerely happy to see the two tribes get along so well!"

Gong Zhe now represents the position of the Goblin tribe. His words represent the Goblin tribe's support for the two tribes.

These representatives of various tribes cannot express their opinions casually. Gong Zhe's statement on the spot shows that the Naga tribe and the Zerg tribe are on good terms, which is very in line with the interests of the Goblin tribe.

The three chatted for a while, and Gong Zhe said that he would immediately build the space transmission channel of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. This time, he borrowed the space transmission channel of the Naga tribe in order to transport the relevant important personnel and materials needed to build the space transmission channel as soon as possible.
